_comment: Necropolis roster. `aspect` is the original's width-to-height at idle, measured with def_extract.py; it is the gate preview.py readability checks a concept against. `body` is the per-creature half of the prompt; the shared style and backdrop requirements are appended by gen_concept.py.
_style: Painterly stylised realism, not photoreal, detail subordinated to shape. Bold readable silhouette, three strong value masses, thick simplified forms. Compact upright framing.

creatures.name: skeleton
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy skeleton warrior, bare bone, hunched forward with the skull thrust ahead of the shoulders, holding a long sword low and angled down across the front of the body, arms tucked near the ribs, short forward step. Desaturated grey-green ivory bone.

creatures.name: skeletonWarrior
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy armoured skeleton warrior, rusted iron helm and shoulder plates over bare bone, round shield held close to the chest, sword low across the body, hunched forward stance. Desaturated bone and dark oxidised iron.

creatures.name: walkingDead
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy walking corpse, bloated grey-green rotting flesh, tattered rags, arms hanging heavy and forward, head lolling to one side, shambling forward step, narrow slumped silhouette. Sickly grey-green and dull brown.

creatures.name: zombieLord
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy zombie lord, larger and broader than a common corpse, grey-green rotting flesh over heavy shoulders, remnants of a leather harness, arms hanging forward, slumped heavy stance. Sickly grey-green, dull brown, a little dried blood.

creatures.name: wight
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy wight, a tall narrow hooded spectral figure, long ragged robe falling straight to a frayed hem with no legs visible, hollow dark void inside the hood, thin skeletal hands emerging from the sleeves, arms held close. Very tall and narrow silhouette, roughly three times as tall as wide. Cold desaturated grey-blue and bone.

creatures.name: wraith
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy wraith, a tall narrow hooded spectral figure holding a scythe upright and close to the body, long ragged robe trailing to a frayed hem, hollow glowing eyes in shadow, gaunt skeletal hands. Tall narrow silhouette. Cold desaturated grey-blue, pale bone, faint sickly green glow.

creatures.name: vampire
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy vampire, gaunt pale noble in a high-collared cloak wrapped close to the body, arms drawn in, clawed hands, sharp angular face, slight forward crouch. Cloak kept tight, not spread. Desaturated pale skin, deep crimson and near-black.

creatures.name: vampireLord
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy vampire lord, taller and more imposing than a common vampire, gaunt pale noble in a heavy high-collared cloak held close, ornate dark armour at the shoulders, clawed hands raised, commanding upright posture. Desaturated pale skin, deep crimson, blackened silver.

creatures.name: lich
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy lich, skeletal sorcerer in a long heavy robe falling straight to the floor, skull face inside a deep hood, one bony hand raised in a casting gesture close to the chest, the other holding a short staff vertically. Tall narrow silhouette. Bone white, deep indigo robe, cold green spell light.

creatures.name: powerLich
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy power lich, a taller more ornate skeletal sorcerer, heavy layered robe to the floor, elaborate collar and headdress framing a skull face, both bony hands raised close to the chest channelling energy, staff held vertical. Tall narrow silhouette. Bone white, deep indigo and gold, cold green spell light.

creatures.name: blackKnight
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy black knight mounted on a skeletal undead warhorse, full blackened plate armour, closed helm, long lance or sword held low along the horse's flank, horse standing in a short stride with head low. Wide horizontal silhouette, clearly wider than tall in the body, rider compact on the saddle. Blackened steel, dark crimson caparison, bone.

creatures.name: dreadKnight
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy dread knight mounted on a skeletal undead warhorse, heavier and more ornate blackened plate than a black knight, horned closed helm, sword raised close to the shoulder, horse in a short stride with head low. Wide horizontal silhouette. Blackened steel, dark crimson, bone, faint cold glow in the visor.

creatures.name: boneDragon
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy bone dragon, a skeletal dragon standing on all fours with tattered membrane stretched between exposed wing bones, wings held folded and close to the body rather than spread, long neck lowered forward, skull head with empty sockets, spined tail curled in. Wide compact silhouette. Grey-green ivory bone and dark tattered membrane.

creatures.name: ghostDragon
creatures.body: Stylised fantasy ghost dragon, a spectral translucent dragon standing on all fours, tattered ghostly wings held folded close to the body, long neck lowered forward, hollow glowing eyes, trailing wisps at the tail. Wide compact silhouette. Cold desaturated grey-green translucence, faint inner glow.
